snippet.title: Rushmark Release Date Trailer | Out 27 October on Steam
snippet.description:
Rushmark is out 27 October 2026 on Steam, 19:00 SAST / 10:00 PDT.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3560890/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_content=releasedate

A cyberpunk speedrunning platformer built on one refundable dash. Your dash is your weapon, and you only get one in the air: only a kill gives it back before you land. Wall-kick, chain and strike through handmade courses, then race any rival's ghost off the leaderboard.

Every clip in this trailer is real gameplay, captured straight from the game.

IN THE BOX
• Ten timed courses that end in seconds, endless Survival, and three Marathon chains: 1-5, 6-10, and all ten in one unbroken run
• A second attack for when the dash isn't enough: an area burst on a short cooldown, usable mid-air or mid-dash
• A tutorial that teaches every technique by making you do it, not by describing it
• Personal-best ghosts, marker splits, best time and best score per course
• Leaderboards, downloadable rival ghosts, achievements and Cloud saves
• A season ranking across every board
• Cosmetic skins and trails earned by rank and by beating par times
• Full controller support and fully rebindable keys

Season two is finished and already in the build, locked: five more courses, free for everyone when it opens.

No ads, no microtransactions. One purchase covers every season, current and future.

Built solo in Godot and C# by Beyond Bounds Digital, an independent studio in South Africa. Coming to Google Play after launch.

#indiegame #speedrun #platformer #pcgaming #gamedev #gaming #rushmark
